terms.meaning: 社寺などの土地を、政府が取り上げて国のものにした命令。
terms.meaning_en: An order by which the government took land held by shrines, temples and others and made it state property.

terms.meaning: 『古事記』に出てくる、手を打つ動作。意味には諸説ある。
terms.meaning_en: A hand-clapping gesture that appears in the Kojiki. There are various theories about its meaning.

terms.meaning: 日本の対外関係史を研究した歴史学者。
terms.meaning_en: A historian who studied the history of Japan’s foreign relations.

terms.meaning: 戦争中に捨てられたまま残っている、毒ガスなどの兵器。
terms.meaning_en: Chemical weapons such as poison gas that were left behind and remain since the war.

terms.meaning: 当時の人が書き残した記録など、元になる資料。
terms.meaning_en: Original material, such as records left by people of the time.

terms.meaning: 同じ一族。
terms.meaning_en: The same family line or kin group.

terms.meaning: 天皇一代のあいだ、元号を一つだけ使うきまり。
terms.meaning_en: The rule of using only one era name during the reign of one emperor.

terms.meaning: 島根県出雲市の海岸「稲佐の浜」。神々が出雲に来る場所とされる。
terms.meaning_en: Inasa no Hama, a shore in Izumo, Shimane Prefecture. It is said to be where the gods arrive in Izumo.

terms.meaning: 農業や商売の神として全国で祀られる神。キツネと結びつけられる。
terms.meaning_en: A deity worshipped nationwide as a god of farming and commerce. Associated with the fox.

terms.meaning: 空港や駅にある、乗ると進む平らな通路。
terms.meaning_en: A flat passage found at airports and stations that carries you forward when you stand on it (moving walkway).

terms.meaning: もとは同じ一族(氏族)の守り神。のちに、住んでいる地域の守り神の意味でも使われるようになった。
terms.meaning_en: Originally the guardian deity of one clan (uji). Later also used to mean the guardian deity of the area where one lives.

terms.meaning: 地域の神社を支え、祭りに関わる住民。
terms.meaning_en: Residents who support a local shrine and take part in its festivals.

terms.meaning: 氏子を調べて登録した制度。本サイトの項目で扱っている。
terms.meaning_en: A system in which parishioners of a shrine were surveyed and registered. It is dealt with in an item of this site.

terms.meaning: 古代の氏族の長。氏神の祭りを受け持った。
terms.meaning_en: The head of a clan in ancient times. He was in charge of the festival of the clan deity.

terms.meaning: 右側を上位とする考え方。
terms.meaning_en: The idea of regarding the right side as superior.

terms.meaning: 生まれた土地を守る神。
terms.meaning_en: A deity that protects the land where one was born.

terms.meaning: 江戸時代の商人の作法として紹介されて広まった「しぐさ」。本サイトの項目で確認結果を扱う。
terms.meaning_en: “Gestures” introduced and spread as the manners of Edo-period merchants. The result of checking it is dealt with in an item of this site.

terms.meaning: 商売や漁の神として祀られる神。
terms.meaning_en: A deity worshipped as a god of commerce and fishing.

terms.meaning: えびす神をまつって商売の繁盛などを願う行事。「講」は同じ信仰で集まる会のこと。
terms.meaning_en: An event worshipping the god Ebisu and praying for prosperity in business and so on. A “kō” is a society that gathers around the same belief.

terms.meaning: その年に縁起がよいとされる方角。
terms.meaning_en: The direction regarded as auspicious in a given year.

terms.meaning: 滋賀県と京都府の境の比叡山にある、天台宗の大きな寺。
terms.meaning_en: A large Tendai-sect temple on Mount Hiei on the border of Shiga and Kyoto Prefectures.

terms.meaning: 君主の徳によって、人々が教え導かれるという考え方。
terms.meaning_en: The idea that people are taught and guided by the virtue of the sovereign.

terms.meaning: 神話に出てくる、出雲の国づくりの神。
terms.meaning_en: The god in myth who built the land of Izumo.

terms.meaning: 子どもが付け紐をやめて、帯を締めるようになる儀式。
terms.meaning_en: A ceremony in which a child stops using tying cords and begins to wear an obi.

terms.meaning: 親のあり方を教えるとして広められた考え方。本サイトの項目で扱っている。
terms.meaning_en: An idea spread as teaching how parents should be. It is dealt with in an item of this site.

terms.meaning: 戦前・戦中の日本での、イスラム教の呼び名。
terms.meaning_en: The name for Islam in prewar and wartime Japan.

terms.meaning: 戦前・戦中の日本政府が、イスラム教徒との関係づくりのために行った政策。
terms.meaning_en: The policy by which the prewar and wartime Japanese government sought to build relations with Muslims.

terms.meaning: こよみ(暦)の方式を変えること。日本では明治に旧暦から新暦に変わった。
terms.meaning_en: Changing the system of the calendar. In Japan it changed from the old calendar to the new one in Meiji.

terms.meaning: 正月に供えた鏡餅を下げて、割って食べる行事。
terms.meaning_en: An event in which the kagami mochi offered at New Year is taken down, broken and eaten.

terms.meaning: 内閣が、大臣たちの合意で決めること。
terms.meaning_en: A decision made by the Cabinet by agreement of the ministers.

terms.meaning: 四角い形の餅。
terms.meaning_en: Mochi in a square shape.

terms.meaning: 神社で手を打ち鳴らすこと。拍手。
terms.meaning_en: Clapping the hands at a shrine.

terms.meaning: 遺体を焼いて葬ること。
terms.meaning_en: Cremation: burning the body to bury it.

terms.meaning: 神道で、神の霊を移して宿らせたもの。
terms.meaning_en: In Shinto, an object to which a deity’s spirit is transferred to dwell.

terms.meaning: 京都にある、江戸時代前半に造られた皇族の別荘。
terms.meaning_en: An imperial family villa in Kyoto, built in the first half of the Edo period.

terms.meaning: 正月に家の門に立てる松の飾り。
terms.meaning_en: A pine decoration set up at the gate of a house at New Year.

terms.meaning: 旧暦の10月の、出雲での呼び名。全国の神が集まるとされる。
terms.meaning_en: The name in Izumo for the tenth lunar month, when the gods of the whole country are said to gather.

terms.meaning: 子どもが髪をのばしはじめるときの儀式。
terms.meaning_en: A ceremony when a child begins to let the hair grow.

terms.meaning: 家の中で神を祀る棚。
terms.meaning_en: A shelf inside a house on which a deity is enshrined.

terms.meaning: 旧暦の10月。神が出雲に行き、よそにはいないとされる月。
terms.meaning_en: The tenth lunar month. The month in which the gods go to Izumo and are said to be absent elsewhere.

terms.meaning: 旧日本軍の呼び方で、マスタードなどの致死性のびらん剤。
terms.meaning_en: The former Japanese military’s name for lethal blister agents such as mustard gas.

terms.meaning: 神武天皇が即位した日とされた日を祝う、戦前の祝日。
terms.meaning_en: A prewar national holiday celebrating the day regarded as that of Emperor Jimmu’s accession.

terms.reading: きげんにせんろっぴゃくねん
terms.meaning: 神武天皇の即位から数えて二千六百年にあたるとされた年。昭和の戦時中に大きな行事が行われた。
terms.meaning_en: The year regarded as the 2,600th since Emperor Jimmu’s accession. Large events were held in it during Shōwa wartime.

terms.meaning: 暦で、何をするにも吉とされる日。
terms.meaning_en: A day in the calendar regarded as auspicious for anything.

terms.reading: きとうぼうきょうじちせいふ
terms.meaning: 1935年に日本の影響下で、北京の東側の地域につくられた政権。
terms.meaning_en: The East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Government: a regime set up in 1935 under Japanese influence in the area east of Beijing.

terms.reading: きほんこくさくようこう
terms.meaning: 1940年に政府が閣議で決めた、国の基本方針。
terms.meaning_en: Outline of Basic National Policy: the basic policy of the state decided by the Cabinet in 1940.

terms.reading: きゅうしゅうていこくだいがく
terms.meaning: いまの九州大学の、戦前の名前。
terms.meaning_en: The prewar name of today’s Kyushu University.

terms.meaning: 明治に出された、教育の基本とされた天皇の言葉。
terms.meaning_en: Imperial Rescript on Education: words of the emperor issued in Meiji and regarded as the basis of education.

terms.reading: きょくとうこくさいぐんじさいばん
terms.meaning: 戦後、連合国が日本の戦争指導者などを裁いた裁判。東京裁判ともいう。
terms.meaning_en: The postwar trial in which the Allied Powers tried Japan’s war leaders and others. Also called the Tokyo Trial.

terms.meaning: 中国の歴史書『三国志』の中にある、古代の日本(倭)についての記述。
terms.meaning_en: The description of ancient Japan (Wa) in the Chinese history “Sanguozhi”.

terms.meaning: 神話で、大国主が国を天の神の子孫にゆずったという話。
terms.meaning_en: The story in myth that Ōkuninushi yielded the land to the descendants of the heavenly gods.

terms.meaning: 神社や寺の敷地。
terms.meaning_en: The grounds of a shrine or temple.

terms.meaning: 血のつながり。
terms.meaning_en: Ties of blood.

terms.meaning: 生き物がもつ遺伝情報の全体。
terms.meaning_en: The whole of the genetic information that a living thing has (genome).

terms.meaning: 「明治」「令和」のような、年につける呼び名。
terms.meaning_en: A name attached to years, such as “Meiji” or “Reiwa” (era name).

terms.meaning: 江戸時代から明治のはじめまで、法令などを板に書いて人々に知らせた立て札。
terms.meaning_en: A signboard from the Edo period to the early Meiji period on which laws and the like were written to notify the people.

terms.meaning: 1908年に定められた、皇室の祭祀(祭り)のきまり。
terms.meaning_en: The rules on the imperial house’s rituals, set in 1908.

terms.meaning: 皇位の継ぎ方など、皇室に関するきまりを定めた法。
terms.meaning_en: The Imperial House Law: the law that sets rules concerning the imperial house, such as how the throne is succeeded.

terms.meaning: かまどや家を守るとされる神。地方によって屋敷神の呼び名にもなる。
terms.meaning_en: A deity said to protect the hearth and the house. In some regions also a name for a yashikigami.

terms.meaning: 天皇や皇族の系統・身分を登録する帳簿。
terms.meaning_en: The register in which the lineage and status of the emperor and imperial family members are recorded.

terms.meaning: 降伏を正式に認める文書。
terms.meaning_en: The document that formally acknowledges surrender (instrument of surrender).

terms.meaning: 「国のあり方」を表す言葉。戦前は天皇を中心とする国のかたちを指して使われた。
terms.meaning_en: A word expressing “the form of the nation”. Before the war it was used to mean a national form centered on the emperor.

terms.meaning: 国が持つ土地や建物などの財産。
terms.meaning_en: Property such as land and buildings held by the state.

terms.meaning: 明治民法で、家を代表して家族を統率する人。
terms.meaning_en: Under the Meiji Civil Code, the person who represented a household and led its members.

terms.meaning: 奈良時代にできた、神話や歴史を記した書物。
terms.meaning_en: A book made in the Nara period that records myths and history.

terms.meaning: 土地や建物などにかかる税金。
terms.meaning_en: A tax levied on land, buildings and the like (property tax).

terms.meaning: 神話に出てくる神。大国主の子とされる。
terms.meaning_en: A deity in myth. Said to be a child of Ōkuninushi.

terms.meaning: 天皇が住む所。
terms.meaning_en: The place where the emperor lives.

terms.meaning: 戦前の学校などに配られた、天皇・皇后の写真。
terms.meaning_en: Portraits of the emperor and empress distributed to schools and elsewhere before the war.

terms.meaning: 神や祖先をまつる儀式。
terms.meaning_en: Rituals of worshipping deities or ancestors.

terms.meaning: 江戸時代に、外国との行き来を制限したとされる政策。この言葉の使われ方は本サイトの項目で扱っている。
terms.meaning_en: A policy said to have restricted exchange with foreign countries in the Edo period. How this word has been used is dealt with in an item of this site.

terms.meaning: 志筑忠雄が江戸時代の終わりごろに訳した文書の題名。「鎖国」という言葉のはじまりとされる。
terms.meaning_en: The title of a document that Shizuki Tadao translated near the end of the Edo period. Said to be the beginning of the word “sakoku”.

terms.meaning: 向かって見て、左側を上位(格が高い)とする考え方。
terms.meaning_en: The idea of regarding the left side, as seen facing it, as superior (higher in rank).

terms.meaning: 日本人の成り立ちを、三つの集団が混ざったと説明するモデル。
terms.meaning_en: A model explaining the formation of the Japanese people as a mixture of three groups.

terms.meaning: 決まった年ごとに社殿を新しくして、神を移す祭り。伊勢神宮のものが有名。
terms.meaning_en: A festival in which shrine buildings are renewed and the deity moved at fixed intervals. That of Ise Jingū is famous.

terms.meaning: 京都御所の中心的な建物で、儀式が行われた。
terms.meaning_en: The central building of the Kyoto Imperial Palace, where ceremonies were held.

terms.meaning: 同じ祖先をもつと考える、古代の一族のまとまり。
terms.meaning_en: A group of ancient kin regarded as having a common ancestor.

terms.meaning: 子どもの成長を祝って、3歳・5歳・7歳に神社に参る行事。
terms.meaning_en: An event to celebrate children’s growth by visiting a shrine at ages 3, 5 and 7.

terms.meaning: 江戸時代の蘭学者。
terms.meaning_en: A scholar of Dutch learning in the Edo period.

terms.meaning: 旧暦11月(霜月)に行われる祭り。
terms.meaning_en: A festival held in the eleventh lunar month (shimotsuki).

terms.meaning: 神社と寺。
terms.meaning_en: Shrines and temples.

terms.reading: しゅうきょうほうじん
terms.meaning: 法律に基づいて、宗教団体が持てる法人の資格。
terms.meaning_en: The status of a corporation that a religious body can hold under law.

terms.meaning: 火葬のあとの骨を拾うこと。
terms.meaning_en: Picking up the bones after cremation.

terms.meaning: 火葬のあとの骨を骨壺に納めること。
terms.meaning_en: Putting the bones after cremation into an urn.

terms.meaning: 戦前の学校で教えられた、道徳の科目。
terms.meaning_en: A moral-education subject taught in prewar schools.

terms.meaning: 沖縄戦で、住民が集団で死に至った出来事をさす呼び方。呼び方や軍の関与の評価には議論がある。
terms.meaning_en: A name for the events in the Battle of Okinawa in which residents collectively came to their deaths. There is debate about the name and about how to evaluate the military’s involvement.

terms.reading: しゅうもんにんべつあらためちょう
terms.meaning: 江戸時代に、住民の宗旨(どの寺の檀家か)や家族の構成を調べて記した帳簿。
terms.meaning_en: A register of the Edo period that recorded residents’ religious affiliation (which temple’s parishioners they were) and household composition.

terms.meaning: 山で修行する山伏たちの宗派。
terms.meaning_en: The sect of the yamabushi who train in the mountains.

terms.meaning: 戦死者の霊をまつる神社。
terms.meaning_en: A shrine that enshrines the spirits of the war dead.

terms.meaning: 『日本書紀』のあとの時代の歴史を記した書物。
terms.meaning_en: A book recording history in the period after the Nihon Shoki.

terms.meaning: 神社で祭りや神事に仕える人。
terms.meaning_en: A person who serves at a shrine in festivals and rites.

terms.meaning: 神への信仰と仏教が混ざり合い、一緒に信じられていたこと。
terms.meaning_en: The mixing of belief in the kami with Buddhism, so that they were believed in together.

terms.meaning: 明治政府が、神社と寺、神と仏をはっきり分けさせた政策。
terms.meaning_en: The Meiji government’s policy of making shrines and temples, kami and buddhas, clearly separated.

terms.meaning: 寺や神社が持っていた土地。
terms.meaning_en: Land held by temples and shrines.

terms.meaning: 後深草天皇の系統。のち北朝になった。
terms.meaning_en: The line of Emperor Go-Fukakusa. It later became the Northern Court.

terms.meaning: ほかのきまりを、必要な変更を加えて当てはめること。
terms.meaning_en: Applying another rule with necessary changes (mutatis mutandis).

terms.meaning: 日本で1万年以上続いた、狩りや採集を中心とした時代。
terms.meaning_en: The period of over ten thousand years in Japan centered on hunting and gathering.

terms.meaning: 憲法や法律の公布のときに、天皇が述べる前文。
terms.meaning_en: The preface the emperor states when a constitution or law is promulgated.

terms.meaning: 物をただで人にゆずり渡すこと。
terms.meaning_en: Handing something over to someone free of charge.

terms.meaning: 母方をたどって先祖につながる血筋のこと。
terms.meaning_en: A bloodline traced through the mother’s side to an ancestor (matrilineal).

terms.meaning: 天の神(天神)と地の神(地祇)。神々のこと。
terms.meaning_en: The heavenly deities (tenjin) and the earthly deities (chigi): the gods.

terms.meaning: 神道の祭りなどをつかさどった役所。
terms.meaning_en: The government office in charge of Shinto festivals and the like.

terms.meaning: 神社に付けて建てられた寺。神仏習合の例とされる。
terms.meaning_en: A temple built attached to a shrine. Regarded as an example of shinbutsu shūgō.

terms.meaning: 神社についての知識を問う検定。
terms.meaning_en: An examination testing knowledge about shrines.

terms.meaning: 小さな神社を整理して、大きな神社にまとめること。明治の終わりごろに政府が進めた。
terms.meaning_en: Consolidating small shrines into larger shrines. Promoted by the government around the end of Meiji.

terms.meaning: 全国の多くの神社を包括する宗教法人。
terms.meaning_en: The Association of Shinto Shrines: a religious corporation that includes many shrines across the country.

terms.meaning: 『日本書紀』などで初代の天皇とされる人物。
terms.meaning_en: The figure regarded as the first emperor in the Nihon Shoki and elsewhere.

terms.meaning: 国家と宗教を切りはなすという原則。
terms.meaning_en: The principle of separating the state from religion.

terms.meaning: 足を折りたたんで、きちんとすわる座り方。
terms.meaning_en: A way of sitting properly with the legs folded under.

terms.meaning: 生きている人の体を切り開いて調べること。戦争中の事件として本サイトの項目で扱っている。
terms.meaning_en: Cutting open and examining the body of a living person (vivisection). It is dealt with in an item of this site as an incident during the war.

terms.meaning: 参道の真ん中。神の通り道とする考え方がある。
terms.meaning_en: The middle of an approach path. There is an idea that it is the path of the god.

terms.meaning: 昭和の戦争中に、軍人の心得として示された文書。
terms.meaning_en: A document presented as a code for soldiers during the Shōwa war (Field Service Code).

terms.meaning: 天皇の位を受け継ぐこと。
terms.meaning_en: Succeeding to the imperial throne.

terms.meaning: 戦争で亡くなった人。
terms.meaning_en: People who died in war.

terms.meaning: 天皇が即位したことを内外に示す儀式。
terms.meaning_en: A ceremony that shows inside and outside the country that the emperor has acceded.

terms.meaning: 根拠がはっきりしないまま、世間に広まった説。
terms.meaning_en: A theory that spread among the public without a clear basis.

terms.meaning: 日蓮主義の宗教家。「八紘一宇」という語をつくったとされる。
terms.meaning_en: A Nichirenist religious figure. Said to have coined the term “hakkō ichiu”.

terms.meaning: 亀山天皇の系統。のち南朝になった。
terms.meaning_en: The line of Emperor Kameyama. It later became the Southern Court.

terms.meaning: 明治のはじめの、政府の最高機関。
terms.meaning_en: The supreme organ of the government in early Meiji.

terms.meaning: 明治のはじめに、太政官が国民に知らせた法令。
terms.meaning_en: Laws the Dajōkan announced to the people in early Meiji.

terms.meaning: 特定の寺を支える家。
terms.meaning_en: A household that supports a particular temple.

terms.meaning: 父方の親をたどって先祖につながる血筋のこと。
terms.meaning_en: A bloodline traced through the father’s side to an ancestor (patrilineal).

terms.meaning: 父方をたどると天皇につながる、男の子孫。
terms.meaning_en: A male descendant who connects to an emperor by tracing the father’s side.

terms.meaning: 同じ土地に住むことでできるつながり。
terms.meaning_en: Ties formed by living in the same place.

terms.meaning: 土地にかかる税金。明治に新しくなった。
terms.meaning_en: A tax on land. It became new in Meiji.

terms.meaning: 明治のはじめに行われた、土地の税のしくみの改革。
terms.meaning_en: The reform of the land-tax system carried out in early Meiji.

terms.meaning: 七五三で配られる、細長い紅白の飴。
terms.meaning_en: A long, thin red-and-white candy handed out at Shichi-Go-San.

terms.reading: ちゅうおうぼうさいかいぎ
terms.meaning: 国の防災の計画を話し合う、内閣府の会議。
terms.meaning_en: The Central Disaster Management Council: a Cabinet Office council that discusses the state’s disaster-prevention plans.

terms.meaning: 神社や寺で、参拝の前に手や口を清める水。
terms.meaning_en: Water for purifying the hands and mouth before worship at a shrine or temple (also read temizu).

terms.meaning: 天皇の命令の形で出された、戦前の法令。
terms.meaning_en: A prewar law issued in the form of an imperial command.

terms.meaning: その土地や村、寺などを守る神、またはその神社。
terms.meaning_en: A deity that protects the land, village, temple and so on, or its shrine.

terms.meaning: 古くからあるように見えて、実は比較的新しい時代に作られた伝統のこと。歴史学者ホブズボームらの言葉。
terms.meaning_en: Invented tradition: a tradition that looks old but was in fact made in a relatively new period. A phrase of the historian Hobsbawm and others.

terms.meaning: 江戸時代、寺が住民の信仰(とくにキリスト教徒でないこと)を証明した制度。
terms.meaning_en: A system of the Edo period in which a temple certified a resident’s faith (especially that they were not a Christian).

terms.meaning: 1月10日ごろ、えびす神をまつる神社で行われる祭り。
terms.meaning_en: A festival held around 10 January at shrines that worship the god Ebisu.

terms.meaning: 乗り物や兵器ごと敵に突入する、生還を前提としない攻撃。特攻。
terms.meaning_en: An attack in which a vehicle or weapon rams the enemy, without the premise of returning alive. Tokkō (special attack).

terms.meaning: 正月にやってくるとされる神。
terms.meaning_en: A deity said to come at New Year.

terms.meaning: 古い時代に、大陸や朝鮮半島から日本に移り住んだ人々。
terms.meaning_en: People who migrated to Japan from the continent and the Korean Peninsula in early times.

terms.meaning: 山口県にある弥生時代の遺跡。多くの人骨が出た。
terms.meaning_en: A Yayoi-period site in Yamaguchi Prefecture where many human bones were found.

terms.meaning: 同じ一族に属する家どうし。
terms.meaning_en: Households belonging to the same kin group.

terms.meaning: 1937年、日本軍が中国の南京を占領した前後に起きた、多数の殺害などの事件。被害の人数は研究者の間で見方が分かれる。
terms.meaning_en: The Nanjing Incident: incidents of many killings and the like that occurred around the time the Japanese military occupied Nanjing, China, in 1937. Views among researchers differ on the number of victims.

terms.meaning: 奈良時代にできた、日本最古級の歴史書の一つ。
terms.meaning_en: One of the oldest history books of Japan, made in the Nara period.

terms.meaning: おじぎを二回すること。神社の参拝で「二礼二拍手一礼」と言われる作法の最初の部分。
terms.meaning_en: Bowing twice. The first part of the manner said to be “two bows, two claps, one bow” in worship at shrines.

terms.meaning: 明治のはじめに起きた、寺や仏像、僧侶の立場をおとしめたり壊したりする動き。
terms.meaning_en: A movement in early Meiji to denigrate or destroy temples, Buddhist images and the standing of monks.

terms.meaning: 神や仏に向かっておじぎや祈りをすること。
terms.meaning_en: Bowing or praying toward a deity or buddha.

terms.meaning: 子どもが初めて袴をつける儀式。
terms.meaning_en: A ceremony in which a child first puts on hakama.

terms.meaning: 戦争中に使われたスローガン。「世界を一つの家のようにする」という意味の言葉で、日本の海外進出を正当化するために使われた。
terms.meaning_en: A slogan used during the war. Meaning “to make the world like one house”, it was used to justify Japan’s expansion overseas.

terms.meaning: 万国博覧会の略。
terms.meaning_en: Short for Bankoku Hakurankai: a world exposition.

terms.meaning: 京都府と滋賀県の境にある山。延暦寺がある。
terms.meaning_en: A mountain on the border of Kyoto and Shiga Prefectures. Enryakuji stands there.

terms.meaning: 税金をかけないこと。
terms.meaning_en: Not levying tax.

terms.meaning: 水をくむ、柄のついた道具。
terms.meaning_en: A long-handled tool for scooping water (ladle).

terms.meaning: 西宮神社の十日戎で行われる「福男選び」で、上位に入った人の呼び名。
terms.meaning_en: The name for those who place high in the “fortune-man selection” at Nishinomiya Shrine’s Tōka Ebisu.

terms.meaning: 京都市の地名。稲荷神社の総本社(伏見稲荷大社)がある。
terms.meaning_en: A place name in Kyoto. The head shrine of the Inari shrines (Fushimi Inari Taisha) is there.

terms.meaning: 「捕虜」と同じ意味の古い言い方。
terms.meaning_en: An old expression with the same meaning as “horyo” (prisoner of war).

terms.meaning: 冀東防共自治政府が持っていた武装部隊。
terms.meaning_en: The armed force held by the East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Government (peace-preservation corps).

terms.meaning: 火葬のあと、遺族が骨を拾って骨壺に納めること。
terms.meaning_en: After cremation, the bereaved pick up the bones and put them into an urn.

terms.meaning: 戦争で敵に捕らえられた兵士。
terms.meaning_en: A soldier captured by the enemy in war (prisoner of war).

terms.meaning: 一族の中心になる家。分かれた家は分家という。
terms.meaning_en: The household at the center of a kin group. Households that branched off are called bunke.

terms.meaning: 日本の神は、本当の姿(本地)である仏が、人々を救うために姿を変えて現れたもの(垂迹)だとする考え方。
terms.meaning_en: The idea that Japan’s kami are buddhas, the true forms (honji), who appeared in changed form (suijaku) to save people.

terms.meaning: 武家の儀式の食事で、正式とされた膳立て。複数の膳を並べる。
terms.meaning_en: The tray arrangement regarded as formal in the meals of warrior ceremonies. Several trays are laid out.

terms.reading: ぼうえききゅうすいぶ
terms.meaning: 感染症の予防や、きれいな水の補給を役目とした、軍の部隊の名前。
terms.meaning_en: The name of military units whose duties were preventing infectious disease and supplying clean water.

terms.meaning: 空襲に備えて、国民に消火などを義務づけた、戦前の法律。
terms.meaning_en: A prewar law that obliged the people to fight fires and the like in preparation for air raids.

terms.meaning: 原典ではなく、ほかの本や記事に引用されたものを、さらに引くこと。
terms.meaning_en: Citing, not the original, but something quoted in another book or article.

terms.meaning: 正月の門松を立てておく期間。
terms.meaning_en: The period during which the New Year kadomatsu is left standing.

terms.meaning: 丸い形の餅。
terms.meaning_en: Mochi in a round shape.

terms.meaning: 奈良時代ごろの和歌を集めた、日本最古級の歌集。
terms.meaning_en: One of the oldest collections of Japanese poetry, from around the Nara period.

terms.meaning: 水で体を洗い清めること。
terms.meaning_en: Washing and purifying the body with water.

terms.meaning: 和歌山出身の博物学者・民俗学者。神社合祀に反対した。
terms.meaning_en: A naturalist and folklorist from Wakayama. He opposed the merger of shrines.

terms.meaning: 神社の祭りを、村の決まった家々などが順番に受け持つしくみ。
terms.meaning_en: A system in which certain households of a village take turns bearing a shrine’s festival.

terms.meaning: 名もない職人の日用品の美を見直した運動。
terms.meaning_en: A movement that reappraised the beauty of everyday objects made by nameless craftsmen.

terms.meaning: ふつうの人々の暮らしや習わしを調べる学問。
terms.meaning_en: The study of ordinary people’s lives and customs (folklore studies).

terms.meaning: イスラム教を信じる人。
terms.meaning_en: A person who believes in Islam (Muslim).

terms.meaning: 1898年に施行された、家族や相続などのきまりを定めた法律。
terms.meaning_en: The law enforced in 1898 that set rules on family, inheritance and so on (Meiji Civil Code).

terms.meaning: 一人ずつに出す、小さな膳。
terms.meaning_en: A small tray served to each person individually.

terms.meaning: 税金を免除すること。
terms.meaning_en: Exempting from tax.

terms.meaning: イスラム教の礼拝所。
terms.meaning_en: A place of worship of Islam (mosque).

terms.meaning: 江戸時代の終わり近くに書かれた、風俗を細かく記録した本。
terms.meaning_en: A book written near the end of the Edo period that records customs in detail.

terms.meaning: 建物に火をつけて攻めること。
terms.meaning_en: Attacking by setting buildings on fire.

terms.meaning: 家の敷地の中のすみに祀る神。
terms.meaning_en: A god enshrined in a corner of a house’s grounds.

terms.meaning: 日本の民俗学をはじめた人。
terms.meaning_en: The person who began Japanese folklore studies.

terms.meaning: 手を八回打つ拝礼。伊勢神宮の神職の作法として本サイトに出てくる。
terms.meaning_en: A worship manner of clapping eight times. It appears on this site as the manner of Ise Jingū’s priests.

terms.meaning: 山にこもって修行する、修験道の行者。
terms.meaning_en: Practitioners of Shugendō who train secluded in the mountains.

terms.meaning: 稲作や金属器が広がった時代。
terms.meaning_en: The period in which rice farming and metal tools spread.

terms.meaning: 親子の関係を結ぶこと。養子に近い関係。
terms.meaning_en: Forming a parent–child relationship. A relationship close to adoption.

terms.meaning: 捕らえて、ある場所に長くとどめておくこと。
terms.meaning_en: Capturing and holding someone in a place for a long time (internment).

terms.meaning: 災害にあうこと。
terms.meaning_en: Suffering a disaster.

terms.meaning: 律(刑法)と令(行政法)という法で治めた、古代の国家。
terms.meaning_en: An ancient state governed by the laws of ritsu (penal law) and ryō (administrative law).

terms.meaning: いまの沖縄県にあった王国。
terms.meaning_en: A kingdom that existed in what is now Okinawa Prefecture.

terms.meaning: 鎌倉後期に、持明院統と大覚寺統の二つの皇統が、交互に天皇になった慣行。
terms.meaning_en: The practice in the late Kamakura period in which the two imperial lines, Jimyōin-tō and Daikakuji-tō, alternately took the throne.
